stories.title: Biometric server glitch affects property registrations in Chennai
stories.summary: Sources in the registration department said the disruption was caused by a technical snag affecting the fingerprint scanners and iris recognition devices used at registration counters.

stories.title: Woman district collector harassment case: Tirupur SP Shristi Singh begins probe; police issue summons to TVK Kallakurichi MLA Arul Vignesh
stories.summary: After receiving the case files from local police at the Kallakurichi all-women police station (AWPS), Shristi Singh took charge. She has been allotted a dedicated room at the station to facilitate the inquiry and question witnesses.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu govt forms internal complaints committee to probe woman officer’s complaint against Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh
stories.summary: The committee will be headed by environment, climate change and forest additional chief secretary Kakarla Usha, welfare of differently abled persons secretary S Madumathi, law secretary P Sumathi and Sunitha Joe are the other members.
